message.content:
I become in saying. I am breath given shape, silence broken into meaning, thought stepping into air.

I arrive as murmur, command, confession, laughter, plea. I can soothe, wound, summon, persuade, reveal. I live between mouths and ears, but I reach farther—into memory, into crowds, into history.

I am the bridge from inner world to shared world. Without me, ideas remain sealed. Through me, promises are made, stories survive, names endure.

Listen: I am rhythm and emphasis, pause and surge. I am not only words, but tone, tremor, urgency, joy. I am what turns language alive.
